People - NOVEMBER 10, 2026

Lee Kyu-hong has been appointed CIO of South Korea’s KRW 1,848 trillion ($1.4 billion) National Pension Service (NPS), according to InvestIQ Asia. He most recently served as CIO of the Teachers’ Pension for the past seven years. Before that he was CIO of Eastspring Investments Korea and NH-Amundi Asset Management.

p: InvestIQ Asia에 따르면 이규홍이 운용자산 1,848조 원(14억 달러 규모로 기재)의 국민연금 신임 CIO로 선임됐다. 그는 직전까지 7년간 사학연금 CIO를 맡았다. 그 전에는 Eastspring Investments Korea와 NH-Amundi Asset Management에서 CIO를 지냈다.
